svg.aria-label: Ten selected projects by Mohammad Fayas Khan
svg.text: TEN SELECTED BUILDS · OUTCOMES · ENGINEERING CHOICES

g.text: 01 / CROP INTELLIGENCE ROVER
Field rover that combines leaf classification, detection, segmentation and sensor context.
EfficientNetV2-S reached 95.13% across 38 classes; Grad-CAM keeps predictions inspectable.
PYTORCH · YOLO · MOBILE-UNET · ESP32-CAM · 4-DOF ARM
02 / LPU UMS AGENT
Closed-loop Chrome MV3 assistant for attendance and university portal workflows.
DOM-first grounding, deterministic attendance math, local IndexedDB state and 139 automated tests.
TYPESCRIPT · REACT · MV3 · INDEXEDDB · EVALUATION
03 / CODE EXPLAIN
Interactive code tutor with Monaco editing, explanations, traces, quizzes and follow-up chat.
Pydantic contracts validate responses; self-repair and provider fallback keep the lesson usable.
REACT · MONACO · FASTAPI · PYDANTIC · DOCKER · RENDER
04 / SMART CROP INTELLIGENCE
Sensor-aware crop recommendation platform that turns field measurements into guidance.
RandomForest achieved 93.18% accuracy, 93.10% macro F1 and 27.61ms inference latency.
PYTHON · SCIKIT-LEARN · FASTAPI · ESP8266 · TELEMETRY
05 / CPU SCHED
Browser simulator for comparing FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Round Robin and Priority scheduling.
Animated Gantt charts and Compare All mode make throughput and waiting-time trade-offs visible.
REACT · VITE · ZUSTAND · TAILWIND · OPERATING SYSTEMS
06 / SMART HOME AUTOMATION SOCKET
On-chip Apple HomeKit HAP server that controls an ESP8266 relay without a cloud bridge.
Active-LOW safety behavior is explicit in the firmware so a restart fails to a known state.
C++ · ESP8266 · HOMEKIT · HAP · EMBEDDED SAFETY
07 / FACE ATTENDANCE SYSTEM
Recognition and geotagging platform for attendance capture with a web dashboard.
dlib recognition, FastAPI APIs, React UI and SQLite keep the workflow lightweight and auditable.
PYTHON · DLIB · FASTAPI · REACT · TAILWIND · SQLITE
08 / ATTENTION IS ALL YOU NEED
Interactive visual guide to Transformers, token flow and self-attention.
The teaching interface turns an abstract architecture into a step-by-step, inspectable story.
REACT · TYPESCRIPT · TRANSFORMERS · TECHNICAL EDUCATION
09 / DESKBUDDY
Compact ESP32 desk companion with an animated OLED face, clock and live weather.
A small embedded interface explores responsive states, readable feedback and hardware limits.
C++ · ESP32 · OLED · EMBEDDED UI · REAL-TIME STATES
10 / FAYASAI
ESP32 voice assistant with an animated OLED interface and low-overhead response loop.
Whisper speech-to-text and Llama responses connect embedded input to an AI service layer.
C++ · ESP32 · GROQ · WHISPER · LLAMA · VOICE UI
